JSON Schema and readExecutionConfig agree on valid and invalid configs (REQ-RW-12)
return { hasUi, hasNonUiCode, hasDevServer, hasTests, suggestedProfile }

falsification.assertion: Invalid .execution-plan-integrity.json variants (wrong schema version, non-canonical path, absolute or parent-escaping completionProofs.directory, empty requiredGlobs/role lists, unknown roles/profiles/capability keys, non-boolean capability values, custom profile missing any of the five keys, unknown top-level typo properties, and Windows drive/backslash paths) are rejected by both the published JSON Schema and readExecutionConfig where applicable.
falsification.evidence: skills/execution-plan-integrity/tests/config.test.mjs cross-checks every valid and invalid case against both validateSchema and readExecutionConfig and validates Carapace's root .execution-plan-integrity.json.

falsification.assertion: Capability drift fires in both directions across all five capabilities (uiAudit, nonUiAudit, fanoutWorktrees, devServer, testGates), does not produce false positives for headless backend dev scripts, npm placeholder test scripts, single-worktree docs-only git repos, or pure frontend SPAs, and reports 0 drift on matching docs-only, backend, frontend, fullstack, and Carapace root profiles.
falsification.evidence: skills/carapace/assets/status.test.mjs tests resolveCapabilities across all five capabilities in both directions plus detectAppProfile end-to-end fixtures for docs-only, backend, placeholder-test backend, frontend SPA, fullstack monorepo, and the Carapace repository root.

falsification.assertion: Uncommitted unstaged, staged, or malformed profile/capabilities edits in .execution-plan-integrity.json raise uncommitted-capability-change while NOW is active (without creating any sidecar files), ignore comment-only or requiredGlobs-only edits, allow read-only verify/status/check prompts, clear immediately upon commit or revert, and do not fire when NOW is IDLE or NONE.
falsification.evidence: skills/carapace/assets/status.test.mjs initializes a temporary git repository and verifies clean state, non-capability edits, unstaged/staged/malformed capability edits, git status --porcelain showing only .execution-plan-integrity.json, read-only verify/status/check bypass, revert/commit clearing, and IDLE/NONE suppression.

outOfScope: Dogfooding Carapace's own root .execution-plan-integrity.json profile and end-to-end fixture validation (REQ-RW-14) remain queued in RW-DOGFOOD-CLOSE.
